versions.changelog: Add UTM attribution tags (utm_source=clawhub) to ClawLink branding links so visits from this skill page are tracked as a distinct traffic source.

- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No other changes to skill functionality or documentation.

- Added the Segment brand logo to the documentation for improved clarity and visual identity.
- Removed redundant file "skill-card.md" to streamline the project.
- No changes in functionality; documentation only.
Full rewrite to new standard: added tool reference tables, 3-step GIF table, architecture diagram, code examples, error handling, and troubleshooting.

Initial release of Segment CDP integration for OpenClaw via ClawLink.

- Enables management of Segment sources, destinations, user identities, event tracking, and suppression lists.
- Uses ClawLink for secure, hosted API key authentication with no manual key setup required.
- Includes setup instructions, quick start guides, and code examples for all major workflows.
- Provides a full catalog of Segment tool commands covering source/destination management, user/event tracking, data import, and usage monitoring.
- All write operations require explicit user confirmation to enhance security.
- Offers workflow for installing, connecting, verifying, and reconnecting to Segment through the ClawLink dashboard.
